title: Piston Range Display
description: See how far the piston can move blocks
body:
# 🛠️ PistonRangeDisplay
**PistonRangeDisplay is a lightweight, high-performance client-side tool for technical Minecraft players and redstone engineers that lets you see, how long your piston can push blocks.**

## 🌟 Key Features:
- 📏 Visual Range: Instantly see the 12-block push limit of any piston.

## 💾 Persistent Memory:
- The mod "remembers" pistons you've encountered. No more vanishing lines when you walk away!

## ⚡ High Performance:
- Built with optimization in mind. Uses smart caching to keep your FPS high.

##  🎨 Fully Customizable:
- Change colors, transparency, and render modes on the fly.

## 🎮 Modes & Usage
- Look Mode (onlyOnLook): Shows the range only for the piston you are currently looking at. Perfect for quick checks!

- All Mode: Displays all pistons stored in the local cache. Great for mapping out entire machines.

**Render Styles:**

- Boxes: Classic 3D boxes for every block in the push range.

- Lines: Minimalist "laser" beams for maximum performance and clarity.

⌨️ Commands & Controls
- **Default Key: [-] (Minus) - Opens the configuration menu.**

- /piston color <HEX> - Quickly set your favorite highlight color (e.g., #FF5500).

- /piston find <radius> - Scans the area for pistons.

- **⚠️ Note: Large values may cause temporary freezes! ⚠️**
- **_if you have a weak computer, better not type a radius more than 64_**

- /piston analyze - Get a technical report of pistons in your memory.

- /piston cashclear - Wipe the memory and start fresh.

## 🔧 Technical Info
- Platform: Fabric

- Version: 1.21.1

## 📥 Installation
- Install Fabric 1.21.1

- Install Fabric API 1.21.1

- Install the mod

- Drop the jar into your /mods/ folder.

- Enjoy building your redstone masterpieces! 🚀
